surfaces: ee pack --since last (per-agent baseline ledger resolution)
ee context --since last (same lane, historical delta surface)

trigger.description: `--since last` asked the per-agent pack-baseline ledger for this agent's most recent persisted pack, but no baseline resolved: EE_AGENT_NAME is unset, the agent has no recorded baseline in this workspace (no persisted pack yet, every row evicted past the cap, or pack-record GC cascaded the rows away), or the ledger read failed. The response falls back to the FULL pack honestly instead of guessing a baseline — a wrong prior would make the delta silently incorrect. Baselines are recorded automatically whenever a pack persists (not --read-only / --no-persist / --no-baseline-write) and an agent identity is set.
setup_commands: unset EE_AGENT_NAME   # or: a fresh agent name with no persisted packs
